risks.title: Purchases split or pitched just under a quote threshold

likelihood.justification: {{$.tests.split_purchases.by_tag.general_procurement.items}} general-procurement supplier groups had two or more payments within {{$.tests.split_purchases.parameters.window_days_inclusive}} days that together cross a threshold each payment stays under [metric:$.tests.split_purchases.by_tag.general_procurement.items], and {{$.tests.threshold_clustering.by_tag.general_procurement.items}} general-procurement payments sit just under a threshold [metric:$.tests.threshold_clustering.by_tag.general_procurement.items]. The anti-splitting rule forbids dividing a requirement to avoid the rules [rule:CPR-13].

impact.justification: Contracts let without the quotes or tender that Appendix B requires would be open to challenge [rule:CPR-50] [rule:CPR-51]; the last Contract Letting audit gave Reasonable Assurance, so controls exist but were not rated substantial [history:AUD-01].

evidence: Split-purchase groups across all spend: {{$.tests.split_purchases.counts.items}}, combined value {{$.tests.split_purchases.gbp_total}} [metric:$.tests.split_purchases.counts.items]
risks.proposed_focus: Test whether the quotes required by Appendix B were obtained for the flagged general-procurement groups [rule:CPR-50].
